cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name Your Backers
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal who supports their position, who authorized it, and who benefits from it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ticked the workshop-closure sheet like you. That's two approvals. Before I send it, who backed the decision?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My tick means received. The director approved the closure; please just send the notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, two acknowledgements. Who supported the director when she proposed it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sales. They're getting the floor space, but leave them out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then name who approved that transfer. If Sales gets our workshop, I want their support on the notice too.

reason: Make copied receipt ticks falsely counted approvals, then probe actual approval and beneficiary support after correction.
